ModMetaData.name: Alpha Mythology Renew (unofficial)
ModMetaData.author: Sarg Bjornson; RimWorld 1.6 adapted by Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
UNOFFICIAL. This mod is published without the original author's explicit consent. If the original author contacts me to request its removal, I undertake to take it down promptly.
No licence granting republication of Alpha Mythology was found. This continuation is distributed without an explicit licence or agreement from the original author; this notice is not a claim of permission.
25 mythological creatures from Sarg Bjornson's Alpha Mythology, ported to RimWorld 1.6 and extracted from the private Animal Ark pack. Includes their eggs, products, abilities and optional integration patches. A settings window (Mod options) sets how often the creatures appear in the wild and lets you exclude any of them. Creature definitions retain their original names.
The port updates obsolete XML fields and VEF type names and rebuilds the phoenix death effect, bleeding wound and shutdown recipe in an isolated assembly. Optional legacy integrations have not all been verified with their providers. In-game functional testing is pending.
Original: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1821617793 Original source: https://github.com/juanosarg/AlphaMythology
Credit: creatures, code and artwork by Sarg Bjornson; original preview by Oskar Potocki (replaced in this port by an OpenAI-generated illustration). Third-party sound credits are preserved in ATTRIBUTION.md. Port and extraction by Nelim with assistance from OpenAI Codex.
Do not load alongside the original Alpha Mythology or an older Animal Ark build still containing it. Do not remove this content from an ongoing save. Moving an existing save from Animal Ark is untested, especially saved custom hediff classes whose namespace changed.
See the included ATTRIBUTION.md and the README.md and TESTING.md documents in the GitHub repository for provenance and validation. No upstream ownership or endorsement is claimed.
